messages.text: No, I have a nano 3s, and I'm waiting on a Thor P2 to arrive from you
Searched the catalog · Hammer Miner DC08 480MH/s scrypt

Got it — so it'd be your first scrypt unit, not your first miner. The Nano 3s and Thor P2 are both Bitcoin; the DC08 mines Doge/Litecoin, so it's a different coin rather than more of the same.

It's $539, ~480 MH/s at ~137W, about 50 dB. Drop-ship presale off the current batch.

What's pulling you toward Doge — the lottery shot, or just wanting a second algo running?
Of course the lottery shot, just like my BTC mining, but looking to add something different.  Want to have multiple options to win.

Then the DC08 is the right one of the scrypt lot — most hashrate per dollar we sell, so the biggest ticket count. $539 for 480 MH/s.

Honest catch: it's a drop-ship presale, and Hammer's dates have moved before. If you want doge hashing this week instead, the DC02 ships from stock, but it's 105 MH/s for $239.99.

Wait or ship now?

Cart's ready — one DC08, $539, plug matched to your address.

····

Shipping shows once you enter your address. The ship date on the buy box at checkout is the one your order is held to — read it there before you confirm.
Before you go, one thing: you already run two Bitcoin miners — what made a second algo feel worth $539 rather than just adding more BTC hashrate?
I'm limited on how many machines I can run at home, so want the most bang for the buck.  For additional BTC hashrate, I'm looking at hosting.
Makes sense. What's the actual ceiling at home — breaker cap····, space, or noise complaints?

Breaker cap···· limitation.  I can put 6 Machines of this size in my office before I start to hit limits of the circuit.  Bigger machines like an Avalon Q or magic miner 40T I'd have to spread them out throughout the house.  Pretty sure that wouldn't bring happiness to the wife, so hosting is more realistic, and taps a lot more hashrate.
Last one, then I'll leave you to it: when you go hosting, is that a decision you've already made on a provider, or still shopping it?
No decisions yet.  I'm looking at several, but haven't committed to one yet.
Appreciated — that's genuinely useful. Your cart's saved whenever you're ready. Good luck with the Thor P2 landing.

context.pop: Would the Hammer Miner DC08 be your first miner?
